bio: Sarah Diodati Gardiner was a daughter of John Lyon Gardiner, 7th Lord of the Manor of Gardiner's Island, and the wife of David Thompson. She came from the main Gardiner's Island line rather than from Col. Abraham Gardiner and Mary Smith, so she does not share the family's descent from Bull Smith and is related to John by marriage only. Her daughter Sarah G. Thompson married her cousin Col. David Lion Gardiner, the brother of Julia Gardiner Tyler.
